architecture_fit: Recommended topology: customer-managed VPC with 3 AZ private subnets per region; Redwood Private control plane runs in a dedicated account with private endpoints to customer VPC via VPC peering or Transit Gateway. Inbound: no public ingress to model nodes; only secure egress via NAT or VPC endpoints to S3/KMS. Egress policy: restrict outbound to allowed IPs for telemetry and updates, support for customer egress proxy. KMS: BYOK via IAM roles and KMS grants; HSM-backed keys supported. Audit logging: export runtime logs to customer's syslog/HTTPS endpoint or S3 bucket with lifecycle rules. Regions proposed: us-east-1 primary, us-west-2 failover (option for ordinals in ap-southeast-1 later). Must validate latency p95 targets and firewall port list (443 for control-plane tunnels, 22 only for scheduled maintenance via jump host).
